freshness.warning: Treat unavailable or unknown actor access as unsupported until verified. UI-only capability is not agent-callable by implication.

human_operator.name: Interactive terminal/TUI
human_operator.summary: OpenCode provides an interactive terminal UI with build and plan agents.

evidence.claim: OpenCode provides an interactive terminal UI with build and plan agents.

human_operator.name: IDE integration
human_operator.summary: OpenCode is available through IDE integration.
invocation: OpenCode VS Code extension (run `opencode` in the integrated terminal to auto-install, or install "OpenCode" from the Extension Marketplace)

evidence.claim: OpenCode is available through IDE integration.
Invocation verified: OpenCode VS Code extension (run `opencode` in the integrated terminal to auto-install, or install "OpenCode" from the Extension Marketplace)

human_operator.name: Desktop or web surface
human_operator.summary: OpenCode provides a desktop application and shareable session links.

evidence.claim: OpenCode provides a desktop application and shareable session links.
Invocation verified: OpenCode Desktop app, opencode web, /share (generates opncd.ai/s/<share-id> link)

human_operator.name: Agent-native file editing
human_operator.summary: The build agent can edit files while the plan agent is read-only by default.

evidence.claim: The build agent can edit files while the plan agent is read-only by default.
Invocation verified: edit tool, write tool, apply_patch tool

human_operator.name: Agent-native shell execution
human_operator.summary: Agents can run commands subject to permission configuration.

evidence.claim: Agents can run commands subject to permission configuration.
Invocation verified: bash tool

human_operator.name: Headless/non-interactive execution
human_operator.summary: OpenCode supports non-interactive run and GitHub automation modes.

evidence.claim: OpenCode supports non-interactive run and GitHub automation modes.
Invocation verified: opencode run "<prompt>", opencode serve

human_operator.name: Machine-readable output
human_operator.summary: Recent releases added JSON transcript export; automation should distinguish transcript export from a stable live event protocol.
limitations: Seed evidence verifies transcript export, not full parity with Codex/Antigravity streaming event protocols.

evidence.claim: Recent releases added JSON transcript export; automation should distinguish transcript export from a stable live event protocol.
Invocation verified: opencode run --format json, opencode session export --format json

human_operator.name: MCP client
human_operator.summary: OpenCode connects to MCP servers and supports OAuth compatibility improvements.

evidence.claim: OpenCode connects to MCP servers and supports OAuth compatibility improvements.
Invocation verified: "mcp" field in opencode.json (type: local/remote), opencode mcp auth <server-name>, opencode mcp list

human_operator.name: Agent Skills
human_operator.summary: OpenCode discovers Agent Skills and exposes them to the model through a native skill tool.

evidence.claim: OpenCode discovers Agent Skills and exposes them to the model through a native skill tool.
Invocation verified: .opencode/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, ~/.config/opencode/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, skill tool (e.g. skill({ name: "git-release" }))

human_operator.name: Plugins/extensions
human_operator.summary: Plugins extend OpenCode with events, tools, authentication, and custom behavior.

evidence.claim: Plugins extend OpenCode with events, tools, authentication, and custom behavior.
Invocation verified: .opencode/plugins/ (local files), ~/.config/opencode/plugins/, "plugin" field in opencode.json (npm packages)

human_operator.name: Hierarchical project instructions
human_operator.summary: Repository instruction files and agent definitions shape project behavior.

evidence.claim: Repository instruction files and agent definitions shape project behavior.
Invocation verified: AGENTS.md (project root, walked upward), ~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md (global), "instructions" field in opencode.json

human_operator.name: Resume, fork, and session lineage
human_operator.summary: OpenCode persists sessions and supports session navigation, sharing, undo, and reconnect flows.

evidence.claim: OpenCode persists sessions and supports session navigation, sharing, undo, and reconnect flows.
Invocation verified: opencode run --continue / -c, opencode run --session <id> / -s, opencode run --fork

human_operator.name: Parallel/background agents
human_operator.summary: Multiple OpenCode sessions can run in parallel against a project.
invocation: task tool (invoking a subagent, e.g. the "general" agent)

evidence.claim: Multiple OpenCode sessions can run in parallel against a project.
Invocation verified: task tool (invoking a subagent, e.g. the "general" agent), "permission.task" field in opencode.json

human_operator.name: CI/GitHub automation
human_operator.summary: The OpenCode GitHub agent handles issue and pull-request automation.

evidence.claim: The OpenCode GitHub agent handles issue and pull-request automation.
Invocation verified: opencode github install, /opencode or /oc PR/issue comment trigger, .github/workflows/opencode.yml

human_operator.name: Granular permissions and approvals
human_operator.summary: Build and plan agents carry different default permissions, with configurable command and tool access.
invocation: "permission" field in opencode.json (allow/ask/deny per tool, e.g. permission.bash, permission.edit)

evidence.claim: Build and plan agents carry different default permissions, with configurable command and tool access.
Invocation verified: "permission" field in opencode.json (allow/ask/deny per tool, e.g. permission.bash, permission.edit)

human_operator.name: Web search/research
human_operator.summary: Web access is available through providers, MCP, and plugins rather than one fixed research subsystem.

evidence.claim: Web access is available through providers, MCP, and plugins rather than one fixed research subsystem.
Invocation verified: websearch tool, webfetch tool

human_operator.name: Artifacts, diffs, and rich result views
human_operator.summary: Desktop/TUI sessions expose diffs, undo, sharing, and transcript exports.

evidence.claim: Desktop/TUI sessions expose diffs, undo, sharing, and transcript exports.
Invocation verified: TUI diff viewer ("diff_style" in tui.json), /undo and /redo commands, /details command (tool execution details)

human_operator.name: Model/provider portability
human_operator.summary: OpenCode is explicitly provider-neutral and supports multiple API providers and subscription-backed authentication paths.

evidence.claim: OpenCode is explicitly provider-neutral and supports multiple API providers and subscription-backed authentication paths.
Invocation verified: "provider" field in opencode.json, opencode run --model / -m <provider_id>/<model_id>

human_operator.name: Model and reasoning controls
human_operator.summary: Model/provider selection is configurable per session and agent.

evidence.claim: Model/provider selection is configurable per session and agent.
Invocation verified: provider.<name>.models.<model>.options.reasoningEffort (opencode.json), opencode run -m provider_id/model_id:variant_name
